cues.en: In this video you will learn about linear weighted combinations.
cues.zh: 這支影片要學習線性加權組合。

cues.en: This is a foundational computational operation that underlies basically all of deep learning and lots
cues.zh: 這是一項基礎運算，基本上是所有深度學習，以及很多，

cues.en: of other areas in applied and theoretical mathematics.
cues.zh: 應用數學與理論數學領域的根基。

cues.en: In the next video, I will start calling these the dot product and then the video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，我會開始把它稱為內積。

cues.en: Thereafter we will start calling these matrix multiplication.
cues.zh: 再下一支影片，則會稱為矩陣乘法。

cues.en: So lots of fancy terms.
cues.zh: 所以，有很多聽起來厲害的術語。

cues.en: But it's all the same thing which is a linear weighted combination.
cues.zh: 但本質上都是同一件事，就是線性加權組合。

cues.en: Okay, so let's begin.
cues.zh: 好的，開始吧。

cues.en: The idea is that we will conceptualize a an artificial neuron.
cues.zh: 我們要把人工神經元，

cues.en: So a node in a deep learning network as a weighted combination of its inputs.
cues.zh: 也就是深度學習網路裡的節點，想成輸入的加權組合。

cues.en: So we have several inputs here.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個輸入。

cues.en: These correspond to numbers depending on the type of neural network you're dealing with and the type of application you're dealing with.
cues.zh: 它們對應到數字，實際是什麼，要看神經網路的種類與應用。

cues.en: These might be data values, they might be pixel intensity values and an image.
cues.zh: 可能是資料值，也可能是影像裡的像素亮度。

cues.en: Of course, in the context of this course, these are going to be numbers that correspond to eventually that derived from numbers that we get from language from text.
cues.zh: 在這門課裡，這些數字最終會來自語言、來自文字轉換後的數字。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So all of these come together, these various numerical inputs come together and then we sum them together.
cues.zh: 這些不同的數值輸入匯集到一起，然後把它們相加。

cues.en: And that is the output of the neuron.
cues.zh: 這就是神經元的輸出。

cues.en: Some more complexities in here that I will get to later on.
cues.zh: 其中還有一些更複雜的細節，稍後會介紹。

cues.en: But anyway it's mostly that simple.
cues.zh: 但基本上，大致就是這麼簡單。

cues.en: Here's an example.
cues.zh: 來看一個例子。

cues.en: Imagine the numerical values of these inputs are eight and five and minus four.
cues.zh: 假設這些輸入的值是八、五，以及負四。

cues.en: These are just arbitrary numbers that I came up with.
cues.zh: 這些只是我隨便想的數字。

cues.en: These would represent the activations of other neurons that are feeding into this neuron.
cues.zh: 它們代表其他神經元，傳入這個神經元的活化值。

cues.en: And what does this neuron do.
cues.zh: 這個神經元會做什麼？

cues.en: Well it just adds up these three inputs and it divides by three.
cues.zh: 就是把這三個輸入相加，再除以三。

cues.en: And why is it dividing by three.
cues.zh: 為什麼要除以三？

cues.en: It's to take an average.
cues.zh: 為了取平均。

cues.en: And that's basically to normalize the numbers so that when we add more neurons on here, when the network gets bigger, this output is not arbitrarily getting larger.
cues.zh: 基本上，是要把數字正規化，避免加入更多神經元、網路變大時，輸出也跟著任意增大。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And so what is the average of these three numbers.
cues.zh: 這三個數字的平均是多少？

cues.en: You know the sum of these three numbers divided by three.
cues.zh: 也就是三個數字的總和除以三。

cues.en: Well that happens to also be the number three.
cues.zh: 答案剛好也是三。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Here is another way of conceptualizing that operation.
cues.zh: 還可以用另一種方式理解這個操作。

cues.en: So we take each of these input activation values and we give them a weight.
cues.zh: 把每個輸入活化值，都乘上一個權重。

cues.en: That's what this W stands for weight.
cues.zh: W 就代表 weight，也就是權重。

cues.en: So weight of this is one third.
cues.zh: 這個權重是三分之一。

cues.en: The weight of this is one third.
cues.zh: 這個也是三分之一。

cues.en: And the weight of this is one third.
cues.zh: 這個同樣是三分之一。

cues.en: And then we can sum up the activations.
cues.zh: 接著把活化值加總。

cues.en: So the numerical values of the activations each scaled by their own weights.
cues.zh: 也就是每個活化值，先依各自的權重縮放。

cues.en: And that's what this is depicting over here.
cues.zh: 這裡畫的就是這個意思。

cues.en: So eight times one third that is this activation value times this weight value plus five times a third.
cues.zh: 八乘以三分之一，也就是這個活化值乘上這個權重，再加上五乘以三分之一。

cues.en: That's for this one plus minus four times a third.
cues.zh: 對應這個，再加上負四乘以三分之一。

cues.en: And altogether that gives us three.
cues.zh: 全部加起來，就是三。

cues.en: So when the weights are all equal to each other and those are equal to one divided by n, where n is the number of inputs, then that's literally just an average.
cues.zh: 所以，當權重都相同，而且等於一除以 n，n 是輸入數量，那就真的只是平均值。

cues.en: It's the arithmetic mean.
cues.zh: 也就是算術平均數。

cues.en: But we don't have to set the weights to be one third or one divided by n, we can set them to be some other numbers.
cues.zh: 但權重不一定非得是三分之一，或一除以 n，也可以設成其他數字。

cues.en: So let's have this be 0.5, this one be 0.3 and this one be 0.2.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡是零點五，這裡零點三，這裡零點二。

cues.en: Now in this case, the way that I have chosen these numbers, they all sum to one.
cues.zh: 這個例子裡，我選的數字加起來等於一。

cues.en: So all the weights sum to one.
cues.zh: 也就是所有權重總和為一。

cues.en: That can be useful in certain circumstances if you really want to calculate a weighted average.
cues.zh: 在某些情況下，尤其是真的想計算加權平均時，這樣很有用。

cues.en: But it's not strictly necessary.
cues.zh: 但並不是一定要這樣。

cues.en: There's no constraint that these weights need to sum to one.
cues.zh: 沒有規定權重總和必須是一。

cues.en: In fact you will also see that these weights can be negative.
cues.zh: 事實上，你也會看到權重可以是負數。

cues.en: Now why do we get a different number here from the previous slide?
cues.zh: 為什麼這裡得到的數字，和上一張投影片不同？

cues.en: In the previous slide, the answer was three.
cues.zh: 上一張的答案是三。

cues.en: And here the answer is 4.7.
cues.zh: 這裡的答案則是四點七。

cues.en: So what's happening is that this activation here contributes more.
cues.zh: 因為這個活化值的貢獻比較大。

cues.en: It's more important than these other two activations.
cues.zh: 它比另外兩個活化值更重要。

cues.en: And it's more important because its weight is higher.
cues.zh: 更重要的原因，是它的權重較高。

cues.en: Likewise, you can imagine this weighted sum being a negative number.
cues.zh: 同樣可以想像，這個加權總和也可能是負數。

cues.en: If this weight were really large and these two weights were very small.
cues.zh: 如果這個權重非常大，而另外兩個權重非常小。

cues.en: So the importance of each activation for calculating the weighted linear combination or the weighted sum is given by the weights.
cues.zh: 所以，每個活化值對線性加權組合，也就是加權總和的重要程度，由權重決定。

cues.en: That's an important concept in deep learning.
cues.zh: 這是深度學習裡很重要的概念。

cues.en: Now I'm going to tell you about a special type of input that gets included in neural networks.
cues.zh: 現在介紹神經網路裡，一種特殊的輸入。

cues.en: And that is called the bias.
cues.zh: 叫做 bias，也就是偏置。

cues.en: So here I have the letter B that stands for bias.
cues.zh: 這裡的字母 b 代表偏置。

cues.en: The bias is an additional input that comes into the neuron.
cues.zh: 偏置是額外傳入神經元的一個輸入。

cues.en: Now mathematically there's nothing really special or unique about this.
cues.zh: 數學上，它沒有什麼特別或獨一無二的地方。

cues.en: The main difference about the bias compared to the other terms is that these all come from data.
cues.zh: 偏置和其他項主要的差別是，其他這些輸入都來自資料。

cues.en: So from text that has been converted into numbers.
cues.zh: 也就是已經轉成數字的文字。

cues.en: And the bias does actually doesn't come from the data set.
cues.zh: 偏置則不是來自資料集。

cues.en: It doesn't come from the real world.
cues.zh: 不是來自真實世界。

cues.en: It's something that is just generated internally and added on to this neurons activation.
cues.zh: 而是在內部產生，再加到這個神經元的活化值上。

cues.en: And what is the point of this bias?
cues.zh: 偏置有什麼用？

cues.en: The purpose of adding a bias is to shift the distributions.
cues.zh: 加入偏置，是為了平移分布。

cues.en: So this allows the neuron to shift this value either to the right or to the left.
cues.zh: 它讓神經元能把這個數值往右或往左移。

cues.en: So smaller values or larger values.
cues.zh: 也就是變小或變大。

cues.en: And that you see here this result was you saw in the previous slide it was 4.7.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，剛才上一張投影片的結果是四點七。

cues.en: And now I've included a bias of minus three.
cues.zh: 現在加入負三的偏置。

cues.en: And that takes the impact of all of this linear weighted combination and shifts it.
cues.zh: 這會把整個線性加權組合的結果平移。

cues.en: In this case it's shifting it to the left by three units.
cues.zh: 這裡是向左移三個單位。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So in Python we are going to explore these concepts.
cues.zh: 接下來，要在 Python 裡探索這些概念。

cues.en: We will start by calculating a linear weighted combination between activations and weights.
cues.zh: 先計算活化值與權重之間的線性加權組合。

cues.en: We're going to generate a table that looks like this where yeah we will just build up this linear weighted combination step by step.
cues.zh: 我們會產生像這樣的表格，逐步建立這個線性加權組合。

cues.en: So individual activation by individual weight.
cues.zh: 也就是每個活化值乘上各自的權重。

cues.en: And then that's going to give us a final number which is a linear weighted combination between this vector of activations and this vector of weights.
cues.zh: 最後得到一個數字，也就是這個活化值向量和權重向量的線性加權組合。

cues.en: Now when you look at these activations you can see that they are not perfectly balanced around zero.
cues.zh: 觀察這些活化值，可以看到它們並沒有完全以零為中心平衡。

cues.en: Likewise these weights are not balanced around zero, nor do they sum to one in this case.
cues.zh: 同樣，這些權重也沒有以零為中心，而且這裡的總和也不等於一。

cues.en: Actually, for both of these cases, the average of the activation and the average of the weights is positive number it's greater than zero.
cues.zh: 事實上，這兩組資料，活化值與權重的平均值，都大於零，是正數。

cues.en: So we are going to explore whether that introduces any kind of systematic error or bias.
cues.zh: 所以，我們要探索這會不會帶來系統性誤差或偏差。

cues.en: And if it did, then that might need to be something that we would have to consider and specifically normalize out.
cues.zh: 如果會，那可能就需要考慮它，並特別做正規化處理。

cues.en: Um, and we are going to do that partly by looking at distributions of linear weighted combinations using histograms.
cues.zh: 其中一個方法，是用直方圖觀察線性加權組合的分布。

cues.en: So we can see what distribution of lots and lots and lots of linear weighted combinations looks like.
cues.zh: 看看大量線性加權組合的分布長什麼樣子。

cues.en: Then I will actually show you how to include a bias term, like what I just showed in the slides a moment ago.
cues.zh: 接著，會示範如何加入偏置項，就像剛才投影片所示。

cues.en: It turns out that there are correct ways and incorrect ways to include that bias term, and you will see that that has a real impact on the distribution.
cues.zh: 加入偏置項有正確與不正確的方法，而且真的會影響分布。

cues.en: So here you see a distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到一個分布。

cues.en: It's generated by a histogram of lots and lots, I think 10,000 in total linear weighted combinations of random randomly generated activations and weights.
cues.zh: 這是由大量隨機活化值與隨機權重的線性加權組合，畫出的直方圖；我想總共有一萬次。

cues.en: And then what I tried to do here was include a bias term.
cues.zh: 這裡，我嘗試加入偏置項。

cues.en: But here the bias term was calculated incorrectly, so it actually did not shift the distribution.
cues.zh: 但偏置項的計算方式錯了，所以沒有把分布平移。

cues.en: And over here I calculated the bias term correctly.
cues.zh: 另一邊，則用正確方式計算偏置項。

cues.en: And now you can see that the distribution is shifted.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，分布平移了。

cues.en: So here the bias term was three.
cues.zh: 這裡的偏置是三。

cues.en: And so the average of this distribution is roughly three plus.
cues.zh: 所以分布的平均值大約是三，另外加上，

cues.en: You know a little bit of just random error.
cues.zh: 一點點隨機誤差。

cues.en: And here I still added a bias term of three.
cues.zh: 這裡也加入了三的偏置。

cues.en: But I didn't add it correctly.
cues.zh: 但加入的方法不對。

cues.en: And so we didn't actually shift the distribution.
cues.zh: 所以沒有真正平移分布。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So now we will switch to Python and explore linear weighted combinations.
cues.zh: 現在切到 Python，探索線性加權組合。

cues.en: So here we are with the code file part nine prereqs Lin weighted combo.
cues.zh: 這裡是程式碼檔案，part nine、prereqs、lin weighted combo。

cues.zh: 先匯入會用到的一些標準程式庫。

cues.en: And here we have the weights into the current neuron.

cues.en: And yeah.
cues.zh: 沒錯。

cues.zh: 這些就是傳入神經元時使用的權重。

cues.zh: 這些則是傳入神經元的活化值。

cues.en: And now we can calculate the linear weighted combination.
cues.zh: 現在可以計算線性加權組合。

cues.en: This is the computation that the neuron is actually calculating.

cues.en: And how do we calculate the linear weighted combination.
cues.zh: 怎麼計算線性加權組合？

cues.en: Well we initialize it to zero.
cues.zh: 先初始化為零。

cues.en: And then we have a for loop that goes over all of these activation values and all the weights.
cues.zh: 接著用 for 迴圈，走訪所有活化值與權重。

cues.en: And we simply update the linear combination according to the activation scaled by the weights.
cues.zh: 依據活化值乘上權重的結果，不斷更新線性組合。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And then it turns out that that value is -1.7.
cues.zh: 結果是負一點七。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.zh: 這裡建立一份表格，可以看到，for 迴圈同樣走訪所有活化值與權重。

cues.zh: 然後計算，或者說顯示，活化值乘以權重，以及這裡的乘積。

cues.en: So that is building up the linear weighted combination piece by piece by element wise multiplication.

cues.zh: 也可以注意到，例如這個活化值是二。

cues.en: But it is completely ignored.
cues.zh: 但它完全被忽略。

cues.en: It has literally no impact on the downstream neuron because its weight is set to zero.

cues.en: It is completely ignored.
cues.zh: 完全被忽略了。

cues.en: So this for loop is I hope that makes it clear what the calculation is.
cues.zh: 希望這個 for 迴圈，能讓計算方式很清楚。

cues.en: But it's an awful lot of code and we don't actually need to write a for loop.
cues.zh: 但這需要很多程式碼，其實不必寫 for 迴圈。

cues.en: We can just implement element wise multiplication and then sum.
cues.zh: 直接逐元素相乘，再取總和就可以。

cues.zh: 這正是線性加權總和的計算方式。

cues.en: Now I want to discuss whether there is a systematic bias in the results.
cues.zh: 現在想討論，結果會不會有系統性偏差。

cues.en: Because the weights and the activations vectors are they're not zero, they don't average to zero, nor do they sum to one.
cues.zh: 因為權重與活化值向量並不是零，平均值不為零，總和也不等於一。

cues.en: So to determine whether this is introducing any kind of a bias.
cues.zh: 為了判斷這會不會帶來偏差，

cues.en: I'm going to run an experiment where I will calculate linear weighted combinations 10,000 times, and
cues.zh: 我要做一個實驗，計算一萬次線性加權組合，

cues.en: each time randomly generating either new activations while keeping the weights fixed, or generating random weights while keeping the activations fixed.
cues.zh: 每次隨機產生新的活化值、固定權重，或者隨機產生新權重、固定活化值。

cues.en: So that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的就是這個實驗。

cues.en: I have a for loop over 10,000, and here you see two little snippets of code.
cues.zh: 有一個重複一萬次的 for 迴圈，這裡有兩小段程式碼。

cues.en: In this first one I am so calculating the linear weighted combination here.
